title: 第一千六百九十二章 巫师召唤出来的东西第一千六百九十一章 消失了的房子
slug: 荒村物语第一千六百九十四章面包
content_zh:
推荐各位书友阅读：荒村物语正文第一千六百九十二章　巫师召唤出来的东西（..la）在那座红门里面，小毛找了个房子，而后和自己的女人住了下来，没有了那个强壮者的叨扰，此时的日子过的，简直可以说非常之不错。
只是因为有花伯出没，使得小毛有些不太舒服。小毛甚至可以说有些害怕花伯，因为最近这段日子以来，花伯变了太多，并非之前的花伯了，甚至腰也粗了不少，如此之人，想必自己还是有些忌惮的。
本来不太待见他来着，可是自己的女人，不知是吃错了药还是怎么，隔三差五的，便要与花伯说说话，有时甚至要把花伯请进了屋门，促膝谈心，道些尘世之俗事，以便散去郁积于胸中的那些个无聊的心绪来着。
对于这样的事情，小毛非常不爽，却又并不敢说些什么，怕得罪自己的女人，那后果当然并非是小毛能够承受得起的。
只好是任她们去了，爱干吗干吗，不然呢？
可是这天夜里，花伯因为夜色太黑，不便出去了，加上落雨，更是如此，非要待在小毛的屋子里不可，那怕小毛不太愿意，那也要这样。
对此，小毛毫无办法。
谁叫花伯的长相较比自己，要略微强壮些呢？
只好是任其如此罢了，根本就不敢说些什么，怕得罪到一些神灵，届时恐怕就真的不好了啊。
因为人们都说花伯有神保佑嘛。加上人家的身体也比小毛来得壮实，此时更是如此了，简直了，屁都不敢放个。
这使得小毛的女人觉得小毛真的是太没用了，自己的女人被人家这么对付，却连句话都不敢讲，这样的男人，唉，不要也罢。
却终究还是留了下来，觉得没了自己，想必小毛的生活会变得更加凄惨，不是吗？
却并非如人们所期待的那样爱小毛。不，一丁点的感情都没有，之所以凑合着过日子，不过是父母逼迫与族中强人撮合使然，谈不上有什么感情！
或许正是因为看出了这样的破绽，在夜色的掩护下，花伯这便悄悄地往着小毛的屋子而去，非要去与之说说话不可。
不久之后，便来到了小毛的屋子里了。
幸好人家小毛倒也大度，并非如此小气，见了花伯，和其他人是一样的对待。甚至还更加的客气，觉得家里有人出没，终究还算是不错的事情，不然呢？
于是夜夜如此，不上小毛这里来做做客，这漫漫长夜，便真的是无法打发，非常难熬，万般无奈之下，只好是厚着脸皮，一次次地拉开了小毛的屋门，不管人家欢不欢迎，直接就坐在里面一把椅子上了。
对于花伯之造访，小毛可以说极度厌恶，只是碍于自己女人的面子，这才稍微高看些，不至于做出过于性急的事情出来。
可是这次真的不一样了。
因为花伯当作小毛的面，开门见山地道着废话，说什么几天之后便会出大的太阳了，而后便想与小毛的女人去大山上散散步，走走路来着。

当然，对于这样的情况，小毛并非不知情，只是因为自己本事有限，能力不够，这才一直选择隐忍，甚至连个屁都不敢放。
或许正是因为自己的男人过于胆小，甚至见了老鼠都有些害怕，不然的话，小毛的女人也不至于在这样的深沉的夜色中去找花伯呀。
而花伯何乐而不为呢？反正他又没亏些什么，有什么不愿意的呢？
可是这天夜里的情形，或许是因为花伯喝高了吧，当作小毛的面，直接就与小毛的女人说起那样的话了，而这样的话，或许只能是两个人之间才敢说的。
content_en:
Recommended reading for all book friends: Chapter 1692 of The Deserted Village: The thing summoned by the wizard (..la) Inside the red door, Xiao Mao found a house, and then lived with his woman. Without the harassment of the strong man, his life at this time can be said to be very good.
Just because Uncle Hua was there, Xiao Mao felt a little uncomfortable. It can even be said that Xiao Mao is a little afraid of Uncle Hua, because Uncle Hua has changed a lot in recent days. He is no longer the same uncle as before. His waist is even thicker. He must be a little afraid of such a person.
She didn't like to see him at first, but her wife, whether she had taken the wrong medicine or something, would talk to Uncle Hua from time to time, and sometimes she would even invite Uncle Hua into the house to have a heart-to-heart talk, talking about worldly things, in order to dispel the boring thoughts accumulated in her chest.
Xiao Mao was very unhappy about such a thing, but he didn't dare to say anything for fear of offending his woman. Of course, the consequences were not something Xiao Mao could bear.
I have no choice but to let them go and do whatever they want, otherwise?
But that night, Uncle Hua couldn't go out because it was too dark, and it was raining, so he had to stay in Xiao Mao's room, even if Xiao Mao didn't want to.
Xiaomao had nothing to do about this.
Who told Hua Bo to be slightly stronger than him?
I had no choice but to let it be like this, not daring to say anything at all, for fear of offending some gods, and then things would really get worse.
Because people say that Uncle Hua is blessed by God. In addition, his body is stronger than Xiaomao's, and it is even more so at this time. It's so bad that he doesn't even dare to fart.
This makes Xiaomao's woman feel that Xiaomao is really useless. Her own woman is treated like this, but she doesn't even dare to say a word. Such a man, well, it's okay not to want it.
But he stayed after all, feeling that without him, Xiaomao's life would become even more miserable, wouldn't it?
But he doesn't love Xiaomao as much as people expected. No, I don’t have any feelings at all. The reason why I live a makeshift life is just because my parents forced me to match up with the strong men in the clan. There is no need to talk about any feelings!
Perhaps because he saw such a flaw, Uncle Hua quietly walked towards Xiaomao's house under the cover of night, insisting on talking to him.
Soon after, they arrived at Xiaomao's house.
Fortunately, Xiao Mao is generous and not so stingy. When he meets Hua Bo, he is treated the same as everyone else. He was even more polite, thinking that it was a good thing after all if someone came out of the house, otherwise?
So every night, if I didn't come to Xiao Mao's place to be a guest, I really couldn't pass the long night and it was very difficult. In desperation, I had no choice but to shamelessly open the door of Xiao Mao's room again and again. Regardless of whether people welcomed him or not, he just sat on a chair inside.
It can be said that Xiao Mao was extremely disgusted with Uncle Hua's visit, but because of the face of his own woman, he was a little more optimistic about it so as not to do anything too hasty.
But this time it's really different.
Because Uncle Hua took Xiao Mao's side and talked nonsense straight to the point, saying that the sun would shine brightly in a few days, and then he wanted to go for a walk in the mountains with Xiao Mao's woman.
Of course, Xiao Mao was not unaware of this situation, but because of his limited ability and lack of ability, he always chose to endure it, not even daring to fart.
Perhaps it is because her man is too timid and is even a little afraid of mice. Otherwise, Xiaomao's woman would not have gone to find Uncle Hua in such a deep night.
And why wouldn't Hua Bo do it? Anyway, he didn't lose anything, so why wouldn't he want to?But what happened that night was probably because Uncle Hua was too drunk. In front of Xiao Mao, he directly said such words to Xiao Mao's woman, and such words may only be dared to be said between two people.
